newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan telecoms shares rise, led by NTT.
newsitem.headline: Japan telecoms shares rise, led by NTT.

text.p: Shares in Japan's telecommunications sector strengthened in Tuesday morning trade, with Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) matching its high for the calendar year, brokers said, as investors were attracted to domestic-demand related issues.
As of 0126 GMT, NTT was up 17,000 yen at 1.01 million. Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) added 120 yen to 7,080. Japan Telecom Co Ltd rose 40,000 yen to 2.24 million yen.
Brokers said that institutional investors were buying the shares to include in their portfolios.
